full_prompt_en: A square manga-style illustration shows a dark-haired figure in extreme frontal close-up, with a vivid red collar rising along both lower sides of the face. The head fills the frame so tightly that the hair is cropped by the top edge and the neck by the bottom. A sweeping white crescent of hair cuts across the dark forehead from the upper right toward the middle, dividing a nearly black crown into a striking graphic shape. Beneath it, sharply arched black eyebrows press over wide light eyes that stare directly at the viewer. Detailed irises and small white highlights make the gaze intense and alert. The left side of the face is heavily modeled with black hatching and stipple, while the right cheek and forehead remain broad white planes. A long angular nose, tight straight mouth, and prominent jaw give the expression severe control. The left ear is visible inside a surrounding dark mass of hair. Near the lower corners, the red collar makes two bold triangular wings against the otherwise monochrome head. Thin black slashes and denser crosshatched areas texture the red, connecting the garment to the ink work of the face. There is almost no separate setting; black hair and shadow occupy much of the upper and side background. Light is expressed as a hard, graphic division across the face, with white planes carrying the brightest values and heavy ink marking the opposite side. The drawing retains precise pen marks around the eyes, cheek, and jaw rather than smooth shading. There is no readable text. The overall composition is confrontational and iconic, using a strict black-white-red palette and close symmetry to focus all energy on the unwavering stare.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形漫画风格插画呈现一名黑发人物的极近正面特写，鲜红色衣领沿脸的下方两侧升起。头部把画框塞得很满，头发被上缘裁切，颈部被下缘裁断。一道白色新月形发束从右上扫向中央，切过深色额头，把近黑头顶分成醒目的图形。其下，锐利上挑的黑眉压着宽阔的浅色双眼，直视观者。细致虹膜和小白高光使目光强烈而警觉。脸的左侧以大量黑色排线与点描塑形，右侧脸颊与额头则保持宽阔白色平面。长而有棱角的鼻子、绷紧的平直嘴和突出的颌线赋予神情严厉的控制感。左耳在周围深发之中可见。靠近下方两角，红领在原本单色的头部旁形成两片大胆三角翼。细黑线和更密的交叉排线赋予红色肌理，把服装连接到脸部墨线。几乎没有单独背景；黑发与阴影占据上方和两侧的大部分。光表现为横过脸的强硬图形分界，白平面承载最亮明度，重墨标记相对一侧。眼、颊与颌周保留精确钢笔痕迹，而非平滑阴影。没有可读文字。整体构图带有对峙感且图标般醒目，以严格的黑白红配色和贴近对称把能量集中在不动摇的凝视上。
style_prompt_en: The manga illustration uses severe black-and-white ink contrast interrupted by one saturated red accent. Broad untouched white planes oppose dense crosshatching, stipple, and solid black masses, creating volume through mark density rather than tonal gradients. Curved high-contrast shapes sweep across a tightly cropped central form, while angular side accents add force and direction. A few sharply detailed focal marks stand out amid simpler shadow fields. Light reads as a decisive graphic split, with crisp edges and little reflected color. Red areas also carry fine black strokes, so they belong to the same drawn surface rather than appearing pasted on. The composition is nearly symmetrical but energized by uneven shadow and a sweeping diagonal. The overall effect is intense, iconic, and tactile, with bold value structure reinforced by meticulous pen work.
style_prompt_zh: 这种漫画插画以严厉的黑白墨色反差为主，只用一处饱和红色打断。宽阔留白平面与密集交叉排线、点描及纯黑体量对照，通过笔痕密度而非明暗渐层塑造体积。高反差曲形扫过贴近裁切的中央形体，棱角分明的两侧重音加入力量与方向。少数锐利刻画的焦点痕迹从较简单暗色域中跳出。光像果断的图形分界，边缘清晰，几乎没有反射色。红色区域也带细黑线，因此属于同一绘画表面，而不像后贴上去。构图近乎对称，却被不均匀阴影和横扫斜线激活。整体效果强烈、图标般醒目且可触，大胆明度结构由细致钢笔笔痕强化。
theme_en: A stern dark-haired manga figure framed by a vivid red collar
theme_zh: 鲜红衣领围住的一名严厉黑发漫画人物
name: Go Nagai
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
